### ArchipelagoEngine
Implements specialized spatial weights matrices tailored to eliminate "ocean voids" and prevent geographic data isolation among fragmented islands.

[View on GitHub](https://github.com){.btn .software-btn target="_blank"}

### roroph
A machine-readable spatial data network capturing provincial links, shipping coordinates, and transit timelines across the Philippine Nautical Highway.

[View on CRAN](https://r-project.org){.btn .software-btn target="_blank"}
